name: Boxx Berry Farm
tagline: It's the last summer for fresh strawberries at longtime Whatcom staple Boxx Berry Farm
description: Boxx Berry Farm is an agritourism farm in 300 Northwest Road, WA, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
